turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I want to sign up for one event this autumn to keep me motivated, and I've found a few.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Let me describe everything first, and then I'll ask for your thoughts.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A half marathon in the city, flat and fast, with thousands of people cheering along the route.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A muddy trail race in the forest, about fifteen kilometers, with some steep climbs and river crossings.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: An obstacle course with walls, ropes and a lot of mud, and you can enter as a team with friends.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Alright, I'm finished. What's your opinion?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: If you want structure, the half marathon gives you a clear training plan and a great atmosphere. The trail race is tougher but beautiful. The obstacle course is the most fun, especially with friends, though it's less about running.
